text:
laura (People Ops): @here quick heads-up — we've published an update to PTO & short-leave guidelines. TL;DR: new carryover cap, a small hand-off requirement for longer absences, and quarterly Wellness Days. Full details and links below.

omar (Head of Eng): thanks laura — does the carryover change apply to this calendar year or next?

laura (People Ops): it applies to PTO accrued starting Jan 1, 2026. You can still use existing 2025 balance as-is. We'll run a 1-time conversion for anyone above the new cap and notify affected people by email.

anya (senior-swe): Quick Q — who verifies the hand-off docs? manager or peer? :thinking:

laura (People Ops): manager verifies. For teams that want a peer backup, add a reviewer in the doc. Template: Team Handoffs > Standard Hand-off Template.

laura (People Ops): Carryover calc example:
```
if balance > 25:
  carryover = 25
else:
  carryover = balance
```

kevin-bot: :memo: Policy doc updated: https://company.internal/policies/pto-updates — last edited by laura at 1760001234

tess (people-ops): Quick clarifications:
- Wellness Day = 1 per quarter, employee-initiated, no manager approval required (use the PTO flow and pick "Wellness Day").
- Wellness Days do not count toward carryover.
- Hand-off doc required when PTO > 5 consecutive business days; submit 3 business days before start.

omar (Head of Eng): any change to holiday blackout windows? We have a big deploy Jan 12-16.

laura (People Ops): no company-wide blackout changes. Teams may declare local blackout windows; ops will coordinate exceptions for critical releases. We'll post any company-wide restrictions separately.

anya (senior-swe): thanks — love the Wellness Days :party_parrot: 

laura (People Ops): We'll run a short AMA Friday 11:00am PST (20 min) to walk the changes and answer questions. Calendar invite incoming. If you can't make it, drop questions here or email people-ops@redwood.com.

laura (People Ops): Links: full policy + FAQ: https://company.internal/policies/pto-updates  |  hand-off template: https://company.internal/hand-offs/template

laura (People Ops): cheers everyone — appreciate the quick read. :sparkles:
